title: Why his band plays different numbers than the other halls' bands
summary: He compares Preservation Hall leaders with his own policy of always playing something different and learning new tunes on request.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand
